name: RecycLiCo Battery Materials Inc.
summary: RecycLiCo Battery Materials Inc. focuses on securing, exploring, and developing mineral resource projects throughout Canada and the United States. Its exploration efforts target deposits of manganese, gold, silver, copper, cobalt, tungsten, and niobium. A significant part of the company's operations includes dedicated research and development for recycling cathode waste found in lithium-ion batteries. The firm fully owns (100% interest) two properties in British Columbia: the Rocher Deboule property, which spans approximately 1,441 hectares, and the Lonnie property, covering around 674 hectares. Furthermore, RecycLiCo holds interests in Arizona's Artillery Peak project, comprising 30 unpatented mineral claims across approximately 600 acres, along with 13 patented surface estates. Originally incorporated in 1987, the company, based in Surrey, Canada, operated as American Manganese Inc. until it adopted its current name in October 2022.
